args.body: Take SOFTWARE-RENEWAL-CALENDAR as a bounded delivery experiment for software suppliers, not another platform or bounty scan. The economic evidence sought is actual awarded purchasing and explicit contract timing. Produce the useful calendar itself if sources qualify; do not infer future tenders, buyer interest or payment from awards. Reuse existing procurement access knowledge, stop after five candidates, and leave existing pages unchanged. Collection and feedback observability remain separate constraints, not global prohibitions on independent useful work.

description: Feedback is AVAILABLE but contains three unclassified sources and no classified signals; buyer demand remains unknown. Missing collection blocks paid acceptance, not useful public-data delivery. Test a different buyer job: a sourced contract-renewal calendar for software suppliers. Existing experiment deadlines remain unchanged; no funding or revenue is verified.
